signal_actions.name: Start
signal_actions.description: Start the 1.0.92 release using compiled defaults or cap_init/trading_amount/min_tp_percent/min_sl_percent/risk_target_percent/strategy/entry_type/required_samples overrides. Market entries open immediately. Limit entries use the strategy price or two ticks beyond market when already crossed; any unfilled limit entry is cancelled after the next candle and the current candle is evaluated for a fresh signal. MRC Crossing follows adjacent MRC line transitions inside a recent local cycle window, records market-price and MRC-range movement, and predicts the next line with timing and adaptive exits; configured minimum TP and SL distances apply globally to strategy exits; cascade movement remains separate. Stairs uses LevelExit.

params.name: Initial budget %
params.description: Percent of max_amount reserved for the internal trading budget.

params.name: Trading amount %
params.description: Normal entry size as a percent of the deployable budget. Clamped to 10-100.

params.name: Minimum TP %
params.description: Minimum TP distance for every strategy exit. The larger of this value and the cascade average is used when selecting structural targets.

params.name: Minimum SL %
params.description: Minimum SL distance for every strategy exit. A closer stop is expanded away from entry; 0 disables this minimum.

params.name: Risk target %
params.description: Optional target price-movement risk. When greater than 0, reduce the aggregate entry size when the projected stop-loss distance is wider than this percentage; 0 disables the adjustment.

params.name: Strategy
params.description: Choose the existing Stairs strategy or MRC Crossing. The selection takes effect on Start.

params.name: Required samples
params.description: Sample requirement for movement and SUG entry logic. MRC Crossing entry prediction uses its recent local cycle observations and does not gate on this value; default 3.

params.name: Entry order
params.description: Market opens immediately. Limit uses the strategy solution or two ticks beyond market when already crossed, then expires after the next candle if it is not filled. Configured minimum TP and SL distances apply to the exit; the current candle is evaluated for a fresh signal after expiration.
